$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-25-batch-c/2026-10-25-batch-c.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

source.operator_quote: 1. agredd just ensure compliance with handbook (show) 2. Agreed. 3. Agreed let's run this 4. what's your recommend.  Review rulings and handbook 5. resolve the decisions disagree - resolve the remainder in compliance with handbook/rulings - show them
source.record: operator chat 2026-10-25 (afternoon, after the integrate-29 push)

decisions.question: compute_maxbld_scenarios: a Layer-2-gated lot emits not_evaluated:<gate> without reading lot metrics; an ungated lot missing a metric is not_evaluated:missing_input:<field>
decisions.recommendation: CMS-D14 (1,522 lots lack lot metrics, 1,521 of them Layer-2-gated; checkInputs throws before reading lot_gate): read lot_gate first; a gated lot gives every scenario not_evaluated:<the Layer 2 gate reason> unchanged (Spec 78 §6.11 :751 'a Layer 2 not_evaluated reason propagates unchanged'), no metric read. An ungated lot with a missing metric gives not_evaluated:missing_input:<field> (the Spec 78 :884 form; never defaulted, Spec 68 §5a part 4), counted by a check, never a throw. If the closed vocabulary (vocab.layer3.status_form) lacks a form, the builder stops and brings a card. Built red-first on wf1/p3-7-prep. P3-7 Q3 (the capture projects key columns only, parcel_id + scenario) and Q4 (no migration-287 *.db.test.ts; the violations.test.ts file lock and the PRECAP-1 pending-set check stand in) approved as recommended.

decisions.question: P3-7 storage follows the ruled O-6: measure real bytes on a sample before the night; over the §6.8 kill line, persist only the headline and per-scenario totals
decisions.recommendation: O-6 is RULED (Spec 78 :700, 2026-10-18): measured against the §6.8 kill line (L2 + L3 <= 10 % of the DB) at the first capture; if it fails, only the headline and per-scenario totals are persisted. The :561 dated note's 'O-6 is still OPEN' means the measurement is open, not the rule (corrected by a dated note). The 3.07 M-row / 11.7 GB JSON proxy is not pg bytes, so before the night a sample of the 20,000-lot probe's rows is inserted into a TEMP table in a rolled-back transaction and pg_total_relation_size gives bytes per row (§6.8 'the trial measures before lock'; no full write to find out). Over the line: the per-scenario row keeps only parcel_id, scenario, status (with reason), total_gfa_sqm, unit count and lineage; the detail is computed on read as for L3-a (§6.8 Phase 3 trial). Within the line: the full rows as drafted. Either result is printed before migration 287 is applied.

decisions.question: No --accept on the seven failing coa-2026-d floors; a pre-registered parser-fix round, then coverage rounds
decisions.recommendation: Floors only go up (M-322): the cumulative headline is not accepted while six article floors and the pooled floor fail. Next, the parser-fix round (CHAT-136) pre-registered under M-321, its miss list adding A0254/26EYK#10 (verify-48h note A) and a sixth named category 'count not read (spaces)' (the 6 registered rows); then coverage rounds for the NO ANSWER classes (12 'clause not keyed (no unit in the agreed set)', 10 'clause keyed without a target'), each pre-registered, blind against its own prior, findings page per M-323/M-324. Wording fix (note F): 'six article floors plus the pooled-articles floor'.

decisions.question: A permits chain run refreshes classify_lifecycle_phase before the ALPD PRE; backup_db is left out
decisions.recommendation: assert_lifecycle_phase_distribution's legacy assert fails live (unclassified_count 259 > 100; the permits chain last ran 2026-07-17), so its PRE cannot be captured on stale data. Run the permits chain from the pushed tip (ead2c4b2) under the DB lock with --only= every chain step except backup_db, which uploads a pg_dump to S3 (cloud write, CHAT-54 = operator). dispatch_notifications runs as its kill-switch no-op (notifications_dispatch_enabled = 0). Then the ALPD PRE (R-JW) if the assert passes; if it still fails, report, no workaround.

decisions.question: Spec 129 P2 decision_disagree compares decided applications only, at the application level; the notice decision outranks CKAN
decisions.recommendation: The P2 SQL compares an item decision to the CKAN application decision, and (v.decision = 'refused') IS DISTINCT FROM NULL is true, so 18 of the 29 rows are hearing notices with no decision on either side, and 2 are partial refusals (one item refused, the application approved). Corrected check: per application, only where the notice is a decision notice (no 'pending' item) and the CKAN decision is not NULL; the notice is refused when every decided item is refused (the per-item 'refused result wins' column rule of Spec 129 :49 is unchanged); CKAN refused = decision ILIKE '%refus%'. Expected 29 -> 10. The 10 remaining are real: by M-326 the decision notice's job is the decision, so the notice value stands in the answer key and CKAN is not used to change it; each of the 10 is re-read against its source document (values only) and listed with its reason in the step's explained list. The check stays WARN and non-blocking. Descriptor change on load_coa_notices: red-first test, then its POST captures are retaken on the next coa_notices DB slot with an explained diff.

decisions.question: Plan facts: lot_* is a survey dimension only when the source is a survey; A0254 setbacks follow the examiner; A0222 height disclosed as a unit conversion
decisions.recommendation: Note C: by M-326 lot area, frontage, depth and corner flag are the survey's job, and M-308 prefers survey dimensions when held, so each plan-facts lot_* value records its source document type and the scorer's surveyFacts (coa-scorecard.mjs:241-250) reads only survey-sourced values; site-plan, plan-statistics and notice lot figures stay as printed reference values. Every moved row (frozen 172/4d and cumulative) is listed; verify-48h measured 0 of 123 blind rows change. Note D: M-326 ranks the zoning (examiner) notice above the decision notice where they differ, so A0254's proposed_setback_* values follow the examiner (4.03) with the decision figure (6.1) recorded as the difference; the note's citation is corrected (CHAT-117 narrows only notice vs plan statistics). Note E: A0222 proposed_height_m 10.01 converted from 32'-10" keeps the existing 'unit conversion only' practice (as other plan-facts files) with that disclosure added to its note; values as printed otherwise (M-333). C/D/E change the coa-2026-d values batch: rebuilt, re-verified, ingested on the next coa_notices DB slot with the P2 fix.
